content: उत्पादक {%a.%} (-दिका|{%f.%}) Productive, effective, bringing about; अर्थस्योत्पादकं मन्त्रिणम् <ls>H. 3. 17</ls>; acquiring. .{@-कः@} .²1 A producer, generator, a father; उत्पादकब्रह्मदात्रोर्गरीयान् ब्रह्मदः पिता <ls>Ms. 2. 146</ls>, <ls n="Ms.">9. 32</ls>. .²2 A fabulous animal with eight feet, called शरभ. .{@-कम्@} Origin, cause.
